title: lasianthus panamensis
intro: Lasianthus panamensis, commonly known as the Panamian lasianthus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Theaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lasianthus panamensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing fever, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing.
